name: LOONEY TUNES
description: The public-domain Warner Bros. run, 1932-1943 — Porky, early Daffy, early Bugs, and the Merrie Melodies one-shots. Ends at Puss n' Booty; everything after it is still copyrighted.
contentNote: Pre-Code and wartime humor throughout. A handful of titles carry racial caricature or wartime propaganda and are tagged individually — they are presented as animation history and should stay off any kid-safe channel list.
rightsNote: BASIS: CLAIMED — download-only, never preload. Every title here comes from the Looney Tunes Wiki public-domain list (itself sourced from Hurst's Film Superlist) via https://archive.org/details/ltmm-publicdomain. That is a credible secondary source, NOT a renewal check: no one has opened the CCE volumes for these. Each item carries its year+27/year+28 window in cceVolumes so the research pass is mechanical. TWO STANDING TRAPS, both live in this exact IA item: (1) the 1970s REDRAWN and COMPUTER COLORIZED versions sit alphabetically adjacent to the originals and were renewed in 1994 — 77 of them were rejected by filename when this manifest was generated, and the pack builder rejects them on every rebuild; (2) Blue Ribbon reissues may carry their own fresh registration, so a clean original-title search is not the end of the check. Items whose notes mention a Blue Ribbon reissue are the highest-risk subgroup. Warner Bros. is also an aggressive trademark enforcer: play the films, keep Bugs/Daffy/Porky out of marketing, artwork and store copy.
